pages.text: A glove of leather and brass, with something alive in the lining. It wires itself into my veins, and through it I steer what the glands put in me.$(br2)Its tendrils never quite stay inside.

$(l)Right-click$(): use the chosen active power.$(br2)$(l)Shift + $(k:chronogenesis.powers)$(): the wheel, while Shift is held. Point at an active power (or turn the mouse wheel) and let go of Shift to choose it. Click a passive power to switch it on or off. Right-click any power to change its $(l)strength$().$(br2)$(l)Shift + scroll$(), glove in hand: the chosen power's strength.$(br2)$(k:chronogenesis.powers) alone uses the chosen power too.
pages.title: Using It

pages.text: Strength runs from 1 to my power level for the essence, at most 3. Stronger costs more: Rewind reaches further back, Slow Time slows harder, Iron Fists break harder stone.
pages.title: Strength
Featherweight
pages.text: Density drawn the other way (level 2, passive): my body made light. Blows land harder, but I fall like a feather, jump several blocks, and can jump again in mid-air, a dram of Density each time.
